sentences.ko: 저기, 괜찮으면 어떻게 할지 정할 때까지 우리 집에 둬도 돼.
sentences.text: Look, if you want, you can keep it at our place until you find out what to do with it.

alts.text: Just leave it at our place till you figure it out.
You are welcome to store it at our home until you decide what to do with it.

sentences.note: **keep it at our place** 는 물건을 남의 집에 잠시 맡겨 둔다는 말이다. 뒤에 **until you find out what to do with it** 을 붙이면 "정할 때까지만" 이라는 뜻이 되어 부담 없는 제안이 된다.
sentences.situation: The Ones That Make You Laugh: Part 3 | Friends

sentences.ko: 아 맞다, 우리 먹을 거 있어.
sentences.text: Oh, I just remembered we do have something to eat.

alts.text: Wait, we've got food after all.
It occurs to me that we do have something to eat.

sentences.note: **we do have** 처럼 do 를 넣으면 "없는 줄 알았는데 있다" 는 뒤집는 느낌이 산다. **I just remembered** 는 대화 도중에 뭔가 생각났을 때 "아 맞다" 자리에 쓴다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 10 | Friends

sentences.ko: 괜히 저 사람들한테 트집 잡힐 거리 더 주기 싫어서 그래.
sentences.text: I just don't want to give them any more ammunition than they already have.

alts.text: No point handing them more stuff to use against me.
I would prefer not to provide them with further grounds for criticism.

sentences.note: **give them any more ammunition** 은 남이 나를 공격할 거리를 내가 만들어 준다는 뜻이다. 잔소리하는 가족이나 흠 잡는 동료 앞에서 몸을 사릴 때 쓴다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 1 | Friends

sentences.text: I did the windows, I did the floors.

alts.text: Got the windows and the floors done.
I have cleaned the windows and the floors.

sentences.note: **I did the windows** 처럼 do 뒤에 장소나 물건을 바로 붙이면 "거기를 청소했다" 는 뜻이 된다. do the dishes 와 같은 쓰임이라 clean 을 안 써도 통한다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 1 | Friends

sentences.ko: 내가 만나 본 남자들은 대부분 그냥 자기 얘기만 계속해.
sentences.text: Most guys I go out with, they just talk and talk.

alts.text: The guys I date never stop talking.
Nearly every man I have dated tends to talk without pause.

sentences.note: **talk and talk** 은 같은 동사를 and 로 이어 "끝없이 계속한다" 는 뜻을 만든다. **go out with** 은 데이트 상대로 만난다는 말이라 친구를 만나는 meet 과 구별해서 쓴다.
sentences.situation: The Ones That Make You Laugh: Part 3 | Friends

sentences.ko: 아무 대책도 없을 때 나한테 회사 그만두라고 한 사람이 너 아니었어?
sentences.text: Weren't you the guy that told me to quit my job when I had absolutely nothing else to do?

alts.text: Hold on, you're the one who told me to quit with nothing lined up, right?
If I recall correctly, you were the one who advised me to leave my job when I had no other prospects.

sentences.note: **Weren't you the guy that** 는 상대가 예전에 한 말을 다시 꺼내며 따질 때 씁니다. 같은 뜻을 더 편하게 말하면 **with nothing lined up**(아무것도 정해 놓은 것 없이)처럼 쓸 수 있습니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 3 | Friends

sentences.text: OH, you should have told me that before.

alts.text: Why didn't you say something sooner?
It would have been helpful to know that in advance.

sentences.note: **should have told me** 는 이미 지나간 일을 두고 "그랬어야지" 하고 아쉬워할 때 쓰는 말입니다. 가볍게 따질 때는 **sooner**(더 일찍) 를 붙여 말하는 쪽이 흔합니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones That Make You Laugh: Part 3 | Friends

sentences.ko: 어릴 때 엄마가 잼 한 통이랑 숟가락 하나 쥐여 주고 영화관에 내려 주고 가던 거 기억나?
sentences.text: Remember when you were a kid and your mom would drop you off at the movies with a jar of jam and a little spoon?

alts.text: You know how your mom used to just drop you at the theater with a jar of jam and a spoon?
Do you recall your mother leaving you at the cinema with a jar of jam and a small spoon?

sentences.note: **would drop you off** 처럼 would 는 어릴 적에 되풀이되던 일을 떠올릴 때 씁니다. 같은 자리에 **used to** 를 넣어도 됩니다. 차에서 사람을 내려 주는 것이 drop off 입니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 3 | Friends

sentences.ko: 나 내일 밤에 데이트가 있는데, 좀 멋있어 보여야 하거든.
sentences.text: I have this date tomorrow night and and I have to look cool.

alts.text: Got a date tomorrow night, so I need to look good.
There is a date I am going on tomorrow evening, and I would like to appear presentable.

sentences.note: **I have this date** — 상대가 전혀 모르는 일인데도 a 대신 this 를 씁니다. 이야기를 꺼내며 "들어 봐" 하는 느낌이라 말할 때 아주 흔합니다. **look cool** 은 옷차림이나 분위기가 멋져 보인다는 뜻입니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 10 | Friends
